definitions.explanation: Goods produced from farm animals — meat, milk, eggs, and hides. A category term used in trade statistics and agricultural policy alongside {農産物|のうさんぶつ} and {水産物|すいさんぶつ}.

examples.japanese: {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}の{輸入|ゆにゅう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Imports of livestock products have increased.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}の{生産|せいさん}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: This region is a major producer of livestock products.

examples.japanese: {飼料|しりょう}の{値上|ねあ}がりで、{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}の{価格|かかく}も{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: With feed prices rising, the prices of livestock products are going up as well.

examples.japanese: {輸出|ゆしゅつ}される{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}には、{厳|きび}しい{衛生|えいせい}{基準|きじゅん}が{定|さだ}められている。
examples.english: Strict hygiene standards are set for livestock products that are exported.

notes:
{畜産|ちくさん} is animal husbandry, and the suffix {物|ぶつ} names the goods it yields. The three category words pattern together and are worth learning as a set.

RELATED FORMS:
- {農産物|のうさんぶつ}: agricultural products (crops)
- {水産物|すいさんぶつ}: marine products (fish and seafood)
- {林産物|りんさんぶつ}: forest products (timber and related goods)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}の{生産|せいさん}／{輸入|ゆにゅう}: production / import of livestock products
- {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}の{価格|かかく}: prices of livestock products
